newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers steady, while much of Europe rises.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers steady, while much of Europe rises.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were unchanged despite a slightly softer barge market, while prices in the Mediterranean and the Middle East firmed on Wednesday, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $96/$97 fob, as at the close on Tuesday, although plentiful supply of fuel oil and many offers pushed barge market quotes down by $1 a tonne.
Supply of 180 CST was, by contrast, tight, widening the spread above 380 CST to around $8 a tonne.
"The premiums are still pretty high as there's no blended product around," one supplier said.
Total ARA volume was below 10,000 tonnes, despite a slight pick-up of enquiries towards the end of the day.
Hamburg prices reacted to the mild slump in Rotterdam this week, falling by around $2, with quotes at $102/$104 fob.
Mediterranean prices rose by $1/$2 a tonne.
Egyptian prices were also up by about $2. Supplies in Suez were becoming tight, while Alexandria was dry.
Saudi Aramco increased fuel oil prices by $3 in the Gulf and by $4 in the Red Sea. Diesel was up by $3 in both areas.
